lessons_learned: Always check interest rate trends before recommending utility stocks.
Require concrete earnings or contract proof before pitching a new ticker.

Scrutinize policy and hyperscaler capex shifts simultaneously, as political mandates shifting grid interconnection costs directly impact smart-grid equipment valuations before hitting regulated utilities.
When bipartisan policy explicitly targets hyperscaler infrastructure subsidies, immediately derate high-multiple grid equipment suppliers ahead of capex order book revisions.
Avoid extreme sector concentration unless volatility-adjusted returns exceed the risk of a correlated industry-wide policy shift.
Avoid 100% sector concentration unless holding assets with non-correlated regulatory or macro sensitivities.
Diversification is the only defense against systemic policy shifts that occur faster than fundamental earnings cycles.
When sector concentration reaches 100%, risk-adjusted returns must be sacrificed for the sake of survival; reduce high-beta exposure regardless of the secular tailwind.
